limitations: The 200..400 ms sampling window, 10% gain requirement and 600 ms remaining-time threshold are a hypothesis, not accepted automatic connection selection.
All 33 timed files verify, but the adaptive medians lose against the desktop engine in C, D and B.
Early B sampling is misleading: the original acknowledged about 300 MiB in 200 ms, but actual zero-helper completion is 4.94 seconds median. The short sample is not sustained throughput.
All 62 real-wire expected outcomes pass on the v3 actual binaries. The example unit suites preceded only the added trial-cancellation counter; v3 lint and actual-wire checks include that counter.
C is scaled to 32 MiB. D is standard 256 MiB with independent random drops, not paired by seed. Three repetitions per tool.
The prototype supports known decoded lengths up to 1 TiB, strong ETag helpers, and no desktop pause/cancel integration.
No new version, package, deployed GUI or release is verified by this diagnostic.

test_correction.interpretation: Initial growth assertion wrongly equated outstanding server handlers with live client helper slots. Region-completion closes redundant responses, but a remote handler may remain writing buffered bytes until it detects close. The failed result is retained. Corrected tests retain observed handler peaks, check target bounds and a single original GET, and prove cancellation through a real shared-bandwidth response with exact output.
